import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds']

# Plot total spending against income, colored by education level
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Income', 
    y='Total_Spending',
    hue='Education',
    palette='viridis',
    alpha=0.6
)

# Customize the plot
scatter_plot.set_title('Total Spending vs. Income by Education Level', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.legend(title='Education Level', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=12)
plt.yticks(fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
